summary: Advanced is plausible as a pre-trial design label. The solver must reason across more than 3,000 substantive runtime lines, eleven COBOL decision interfaces, shell orchestration and SQL durability while preserving restart provenance, route-specific exactly-once effects, accounting completeness, cycle-scoped reconciliation and delayed close authorization. The 29 manifestations are not independent trivia: six root-cause clusters and 27 causal edges create partial-fix traps. Final difficulty remains explicitly unmeasured until the authorized combined model trials are run later.

evidence.observation: 3055 substantive solver-visible LOC, 29 manifestations, six root causes, 29 interrelated manifestations and 27 causal edges; 37 tests with 30 F2P.
Each root-cause cluster has downstream partial-fix traps; identity, resume, accounting and close defects cross COBOL/shell/SQL boundaries.
A correct solution must distinguish cross-cycle replay from current-cycle restart state and validate durable internal/external effects before continuation.
Balanced reconciliation is separate from completion, with population, route, ledger and operational-close invariants.
The untouched starter fails all 30 F2P cases while the reference solution passes all 37, showing a broad non-trivial repair surface without verifier contradiction.
